title: Local and global minimality of the lamella for the anisotropic Ohta-Kawasaki energy
summary: In this paper we consider the volume-constrained minimization of a variant of the Ohta-Kawasaki functional with an anisotropic surface energy replacing the standard perimeter. Following and suitably adapting the second variation approach devised in arXiv:1211.0164, we prove local minimality results for the horizontal lamellar configuration, in analogy with the isotropic case, under the assumption that the anisotropy is uniformly elliptic.
